note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 8669 Section 3.1 ('Flags: 16 bits of flags. None are defined by this document. The Flags field MUST be clear on transmission'). Verified attribute.EncodePrefixSID and parsePrefixSIDWithSRGB (internal/core/bgp/attribute/prefixsid.go) emit Flags=0x0000, and session_prefix_sid.go::clearLabelIndexTLVs (invoked by session_egress_normalize.go::normalizeTransmittedUpdate) zeroes Label-Index Flags on IPv4/IPv6 labeled unicast while leaving unknown TLVs and Originator SRGB unmodified. Positives assert exact zero Flags on bare and SRGB-form encoders (TestRFC8669LabelIndexTLVReservedAndFlagsClearOnTransmission, TestRFC8669SRGBFormLabelIndexReservedAndFlagsClearOnTransmission), family-gated egress clearing on IPv4/IPv6 LU (TestClearTransmittedLabelIndexOnlyOnLabeledUnicast), and clean transmission across all 6 writer/relay rails (TestRFC8669LabelIndexTransmissionClearsReservedAndFlags). Negative sends dirty Flags=0x5aff across all 6 rails and asserts exact cleared wire bytes without mutating borrowed source or Originator SRGB. Q1-Q4 pass.
